name: Story poll plan
summary: A two-option poll sticker on a friend's story that turns into the winning plan card once the vote is decided.
useWhen: a story asking friends to pick between two plans: 'beach or hike sat?'
a this-or-that poll that should end as a plan with a time and place
dontUseWhen: no plan details for either side yet (use a plain poll)

params.author: whose story
params.caption: story text
params.question: string
params.options: 2 x {label, art: beach|hike|plain, title, when, place, rows: [label, value][] (0-3), alt, voters: names}
